props.name: className
props.comment: A class name to apply to the `<span>`.

props.name: currency
props.comment: ISO-4217 currency code (e.g. 'USD'). Required when value is a plain number.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: The value shown when the one at `source` is `undefined`.

props.name: displayLocale
props.comment: The locale to format in. Defaults to the `i18n` locale, then the runtime's.

props.name: empty
props.comment:
The text shown when the value is empty. Translated through `i18n` when one
is given, printed as is otherwise. With none, the field renders nothing.

props.name: record
props.comment: The record to read. Required: there is no record context to fall back on.

props.name: source
props.comment: Name of the property to display (dot/bracket path).

props.name: storeAsMinorUnits
props.comment: Treat the stored value as minor units (cents) and divide by 100.
